TOP: Cisco Expressway root RCE under active attack
AI agents hit root access in 11 minutes

P.h: Cisco Expressway root RCE is under active attack, CISA sets deadline
P.p: Attackers exploited a hard-coded credential and weak certificate validation flaw in clustered Cisco Expressway-C and Expressway-E gateways to get unauthenticated root command execution. F6 saw two internet-facing devices compromised, then two internal cluster nodes, with Python scripts hunting SMB, SQL Server, WinRM and GitLab credentials.
P.s: CISA added the 9.8 CVSS bug to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog and set a Monday patch deadline for federal agencies. TLDR IT carries the same story. Patch clustered Expressway now and review internal nodes.

items.h: AI agents go from flaw to root in 11 minutes
items.d: A China-linked actor used Cairn agents on East Asian universities for about 48 hours. 148 actions hit an exposed Redis server, over 30,000 SSH credential combos were tried, then a path-traversal bug in a medical imaging app gave a root reverse shell.

items.h: Six WP Connect plugins backdoored via developer account
items.d: Backdoored releases hit within about two hours and ran remote PHP through eval(). WordPress.org's new release cooling-off hold blocked updates before any site got them. Check versions, remove them, scan for webshells.

items.h: binary-parser code injection, CVSS up to 9.2
items.d: Versions before 2.3.1 let an attacker who controls parser definitions inject JavaScript at compile time. Trusted definitions parsing untrusted data are unaffected. Update to 2.3.1.

items.h: Sandboxing AI coding agents: four tools compared
items.d: Kudelski tested nono, Docker Sandboxes, Microsandbox and NVIDIA OpenShell. All scored 4 to 4.5 of 5. Only nono and OpenShell scope credentials to domain and endpoint.

items.h: Project Zero: one bit bypasses VirtualBox hardening
items.d: Clearing one PE header bit lets untrusted .NET code load in hardened processes. WDAC users should enable Dynamic Code Security.

P.h: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in all-stock deal, pitching a control plane for AI agents
P.p: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler for about $43.9 billion, a roughly 34% premium, adding Zero Trust SASE to the Falcon platform. The combined firm expects more than $10 billion in ARR and pitches single-dataset telemetry as the control plane for securing AI agents.
P.s: Synergy figures are the companies' own projections. Close is expected in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal 2028, pending approvals. TLDR IT says it could reshape enterprise security purchasing.

tiles.t: Google donates Agent Substrate and gVisor to CNCF
tiles.d: Built to run AI agents securely at scale. Google says agents resume in under 500 ms from pre-warmed Kubernetes pools.

tiles.t: Ambient networking is GA on GKE
tiles.d: Sidecar-less service mesh moves networking into shared per-node components. TLDR IT and DevOps both cover it.
Preview for VPC-native clusters on GKE 1.35+. No parallel cluster, rollback before finalization.
Four layers, three concerns: reliability, cost, security. Agents rarely error, they answer confidently wrong.
Dynamic Resource Allocation support and node repair that respects Pod Disruption Budgets.

P.h: Microsoft mega outage: a Windows defect hid for months, then swamped gateways
P.p: Microsoft's final incident report says a Windows defect went undetected for months before overwhelming Microsoft 365 gateway servers. At peak, more than 80% of North American gateway servers were unresponsive.
P.s: Microsoft names gaps in load testing, failover procedures and infrastructure capacity, and plans better service isolation and recovery. The Register headline notes emails that never arrived.

tiles.t: Network Firewall filters at VPC internet gateways
tiles.d: Preview needs no routing changes, includes NAT and auto-extends policy to new VPCs and subnets.
AI secret detection for air-gapped sites, wider malware detection, default Dependabot cooldown.
Only 0.6 to 0.8% of CVEs are exploited. Median disclosure-to-exploit fell to 33 days in 2026 from 163 in 2024.
Automate remediation and agent deployment in Azure and Google Cloud from one place.
Microsoft confirms November's Windows 11 hotpatch failures. Registry workaround needs a restart.

items.h: AI supply chain leaks data: 2M canaries planted
items.d: Researchers planted two million canary tokens and found an ecosystem that leaked highly sensitive data like a sieve. Reported by TLDR via Ars Technica.

items.h: Claude Ship can review, fix and approve pull requests
items.d: If team policy allows it. TLDR lists it in quick links.

items.h: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO
items.d: Board reinstated him less than two weeks after resigning. TLDR says Trump personally promised he broke no national security laws. TLDR IT notes less leadership uncertainty for AI infrastructure.

items.h: Anthropic researcher claims AI-assisted Riemann proof
items.d: Passed proof-checking software, per TLDR. It is a claim, not yet community-verified.
